title: AiBatchReadResult
description: ai.batch-read-result@1: the answers of ai.batches.read on OpenVibe.AI (the caller's own batches). GET /api/v1/batches → { batches } (newest first, the items not included); GET /api/v1/batches/:id → { batch } (with its items). Somebody else's batch is 404 batch.not_found.
